meaning.en: Writers, poets and other literary people.
meaning.zh: 泛指文人、诗人、书画家等风雅之士。

examples.zh: 西湖自古吸引了无数文人墨客。
examples.en: West Lake has drawn countless writers and poets since ancient times.

examples.zh: 这家茶馆曾是文人墨客聚会的地方。
examples.en: This teahouse was once a gathering place for the literati.

usage.en: Subject or object; often with 吸引/留下.

meaning.en: Fond of eating but too lazy to work.
meaning.zh: 贪图吃喝，懒于做事。

examples.zh: 他好吃懒做，三十岁了还靠父母养着。
examples.en: He's greedy and bone idle — thirty and still living off his parents.

examples.zh: 老人常拿好吃懒做的人做反面例子教育孩子。
examples.en: Old people often hold up lazy gluttons as a warning to children.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; critical.

meaning.en: Opinions differ and no one can say which is right.
meaning.zh: 意见分歧，不能得出一致的结论。

examples.zh: 关于这个问题，专家们众说纷纭，莫衷一是。
examples.en: Experts are divided on this question and there's no consensus.

examples.zh: 网上的说法莫衷一是，还是看官方通知吧。
examples.en: The claims online are all over the place — better to check the official notice.

usage.en: Predicate; often after 众说纷纭.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“众说纷纭”连用。

synonyms: 公说公有理，婆说婆有理

meaning.en: So firm that it cannot be broken.
meaning.zh: 坚固得不能摧毁。多形容关系、信念等十分牢固。

examples.zh: 两国之间建立了牢不可破的友谊。
examples.en: The two countries have forged an unbreakable friendship.

examples.zh: 这种偏见在他心里已经牢不可破。
examples.en: This prejudice has become deeply entrenched in his mind.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; often of friendship, alliances, beliefs.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，常修饰友谊、联盟等。

meaning.en: To mention someone explicitly by name.
meaning.zh: 直接说出对方的姓名。

examples.zh: 他在会上指名道姓地批评了两个部门。
examples.en: At the meeting he criticised two departments by name.

examples.zh: 她没有指名道姓，但大家都知道她说的是谁。
examples.en: She didn't name names, but everyone knew who she meant.

usage.en: Adverbial (指名道姓地…) or predicate.

meaning.en: Hard and full of twists and turns.
meaning.zh: 形容经历的过程困难而不顺利。

examples.zh: 这项研究经历了艰难曲折的过程。
examples.en: This research went through a long and tortuous process.

examples.zh: 回顾创业初期，道路十分艰难曲折。
examples.en: Looking back on the early days of the business, the road was full of hardships.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; common in formal writing.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，多用于书面语。

meaning.en: To repeat what others say without thinking for oneself.
meaning.zh: 别人怎么说，自己也跟着怎么说，没有主见。

examples.zh: 看问题要有自己的判断，不能人云亦云。
examples.en: You need your own judgement, not just parrot what others say.

examples.zh: 网上很多评论都是人云亦云。
examples.en: Many comments online just follow the herd.

usage.en: Predicate; often 不能/不要人云亦云.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不能人云亦云”。

antonyms: 独立之精神，自由之思想

meaning.en: To stop just in time before disaster.
meaning.zh: 在悬崖边上勒住马。比喻到了危险边缘及时醒悟回头。

examples.zh: 你现在悬崖勒马还来得及。
examples.en: It's not too late to pull back from the brink.

examples.zh: 幸好他悬崖勒马，没有签那份合同。
examples.en: Luckily he stopped himself in time and didn't sign that contract.

usage.en: Predicate.

pinyin: duō yī shì bù rú shǎo yī shì
literal: more · one · matter · not · as good as · less · one · matter
natural: better to stay out of it

meaning.en: It is better to avoid extra trouble than to get involved.
meaning.zh: 与其多管一件事，不如少管一件事。指怕惹麻烦，不愿多管闲事。

examples.zh: 他抱着多一事不如少一事的态度，对问题视而不见。
examples.en: With a 'don't go looking for trouble' attitude, he turned a blind eye to the problem.

examples.zh: 算了，多一事不如少一事，别去管人家的闲事了。
examples.en: Forget it — the less fuss the better. Don't meddle in their business.

usage.en: Often as advice or in 抱着…的态度; can sound passive.
usage.zh: 常作劝说语，或说“抱着多一事不如少一事的态度”。

meaning.en: The sky clears after rain; things improve after a bad spell.
meaning.zh: 雨后转晴。比喻黑暗过去，光明到来，或困境过去。

equivalents: after the storm comes the calm
every cloud has a silver lining

examples.zh: 一场大雨后，雨过天晴，空气格外清新。
examples.en: After the downpour the sky cleared and the air was wonderfully fresh.

examples.zh: 经过几个月的风波，公司终于雨过天晴。
examples.en: After months of turmoil, the company finally came through the storm.

usage.en: Predicate or independent clause.

meaning.en: To treat others with goodwill and help them do well.
meaning.zh: 原指赞同别人做好事，现指善意地对待和帮助别人。

equivalents: give people the benefit of the doubt

examples.zh: 她一向与人为善，人缘特别好。
examples.en: She's always kind to others, so everyone likes her.

examples.zh: 批评同事要本着与人为善的态度。
examples.en: Criticism of colleagues should be offered in a spirit of goodwill.

story.en: Mencius praised the sage Shun for learning from others' goodness: 'to take from others in order to do good is to do good together with others' (与人为善).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“取诸人以为善，是与人为善者也。故君子莫大乎与人为善。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

natural: drive out evil and promote good

meaning.en: To get rid of the bad and promote the good.
meaning.zh: 冲去污水，让清水上来。比喻清除坏的，发扬好的。

equivalents: root out evil and promote good

examples.zh: 舆论监督能起到激浊扬清的作用。
examples.en: Media oversight can help root out the bad and promote the good.

examples.zh: 新任局长决心激浊扬清，整顿作风。
examples.en: The new director is determined to clean house and restore integrity.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; formal.

meaning.en: Brilliantly lit up.
meaning.zh: 形容灯光明亮，景象繁华。

examples.zh: 夜晚的外滩灯火辉煌。
examples.en: At night the Bund is ablaze with lights.

examples.zh: 除夕之夜，家家户户灯火辉煌。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve every home is brightly lit.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

meaning.en: Broad daylight; in full public view.
meaning.zh: 比喻大家看得很清楚的场合，多用于“光天化日之下”。

examples.zh: 光天化日之下竟然有人抢劫！
examples.en: Someone committed a robbery in broad daylight!

examples.zh: 他们光天化日之下公然造假。
examples.en: They faked the figures brazenly, in full view of everyone.

usage.en: Almost always 光天化日之下, stressing a brazen act.
usage.zh: 多用“光天化日之下”，强调公然作恶。

meaning.en: What the people support and long for.
meaning.zh: 人们心里所向往、拥护的。

examples.zh: 和平发展是人心所向。
examples.en: Peaceful development is what the people want.

examples.zh: 改革是大势所趋，人心所向。
examples.en: Reform is the trend of the times and the will of the people.

usage.en: Predicate (是人心所向); often with 大势所趋.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“大势所趋”连用。

meaning.en: Scattered about in disorder.
meaning.zh: 形容零散稀落或杂乱不整齐的样子。

examples.zh: 一场大风过后，院子里的花盆倒得七零八落。
examples.en: After the gale the flowerpots in the yard were knocked over everywhere.

examples.zh: 我们队被对手打得七零八落。
examples.en: Our team was torn to pieces by the opposition.

usage.en: Complement (…得七零八落) or predicate.

natural: the world has changed beyond recognition

meaning.en: Seas turn into fields — great changes over time.
meaning.zh: 大海变成桑田，桑田变成大海。比喻世事变化巨大。

examples.zh: 几十年过去，故乡已是沧海桑田。
examples.en: Decades on, my hometown has changed beyond recognition.

examples.zh: 老人感慨地说起了这些年的沧海桑田。
examples.en: The old man spoke wistfully of all the upheavals over the years.

story.en: The immortal Magu told Wang Fangping that since they last met she had seen the Eastern Sea turn into mulberry fields three times.
story.zh: 《神仙传》麻姑自说：“接待以来，已见东海三为桑田。”

usage.en: Subject, object or predicate; literary.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语、谓语，书面语。

meaning.en: Disgusting; making one feel sick.
meaning.zh: 让人恶心想吐。比喻使人极端厌恶。

examples.zh: 垃圾堆散发出令人作呕的气味。
examples.en: The rubbish heap gave off a nauseating smell.

examples.zh: 他那副阿谀奉承的样子真令人作呕。
examples.en: His fawning manner is truly sickening.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

synonyms: 癞蛤蟆爬到脚背上——不咬人也膈应人

meaning.en: Wind and rain lashing down at once; trouble on all sides.
meaning.zh: 又刮风又下雨。也比喻几种灾难同时袭来。

examples.zh: 那是一个风雨交加的夜晚。
examples.en: It was a dark and stormy night.

examples.zh: 尽管风雨交加，救援队仍连夜赶到。
examples.en: Despite the lashing wind and rain, the rescue team arrived overnight.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (风雨交加的夜晚).

meaning.en: Heart failure; also, utter mental and physical exhaustion.
meaning.zh: 医学上指心脏功能衰竭；也形容精神和体力极度疲惫。

examples.zh: 老人因心力衰竭住进了医院。
examples.en: The old man was admitted to hospital with heart failure.

examples.zh: 连续加班一个月，他感到心力衰竭。
examples.en: After a month of overtime he felt utterly drained.

usage.en: Mainly a medical term; figurative use is less common (心力交瘁 is the usual idiom).
usage.zh: 主要是医学术语；比喻疲惫时多用“心力交瘁”。

meaning.en: To change one's mind and come round, especially to drop a grudge.
meaning.zh: 改变原来的想法和态度，多指不再坚持原来的成见或决定。

examples.zh: 她终于回心转意，答应回家了。
examples.en: She finally came round and agreed to come home.

examples.zh: 我们再劝劝他，说不定他会回心转意。
examples.en: Let's try talking to him again — he might change his mind.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: To be daunted or intimidated just by the sight of something.
meaning.zh: 看到了就害怕。

examples.zh: 这本厚厚的教材让很多学生望而生畏。
examples.en: Many students find this thick textbook daunting.

examples.zh: 他表情严肃，让人望而生畏。
examples.en: His stern expression makes people wary of approaching him.

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人/让人望而生畏.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人望而生畏”。

meaning.en: Having nothing good about it at all.
meaning.zh: 没有一点对的或好的地方。

examples.zh: 别把自己说得一无是处。
examples.en: Don't talk about yourself as if you're good for nothing.

examples.zh: 这个方案并非一无是处，只是需要改进。
examples.en: The plan isn't entirely without merit; it just needs work.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (说得一无是处).

literal: raise · son · guard against · old age
natural: raise children to care for you in old age

meaning.en: To bring up children so that they will look after you when you are old.
meaning.zh: 养育儿女，以备年老时有人奉养。

equivalents: raise kids to look after you in old age

examples.zh: “养儿防老”的观念在农村仍然很普遍。
examples.en: The idea of raising children to support you in old age is still common in rural areas.

examples.zh: 随着养老保险的普及，养儿防老的想法正在改变。
examples.en: With the spread of pension insurance, the notion of children as a pension is changing.

usage.en: Often quoted as a traditional idea; full saying 养儿防老，积谷防饥.
usage.zh: 常作为传统观念被引用，全句为“养儿防老，积谷防饥”。
